intro.text: An honorspren whose Windrunner, Vratim, was killed in battle.

items.text: Yunfah was one of the honorspren who left Shadesmar, against the wishes of senior honorspren, to bond humans. He bonded Vratim and made them a Windrunner, but Vratim died in battle.
Some months on, Kaladin ordered Yunfah to try to bond Rlain within ten days, and he reluctantly agreed.

appearance.text: He can change his shape and size like other honorspren. Kaladin sees him as a tiny old man with a long beard, riding a small cloud.

personality.text: He seems little affected by his Radiant's death. He respects hierarchy, treats Kaladin as his superior, and hates the idea of bonding a singer. Syl says he loves the Physical Realm and doesn't want to go back to Shadesmar.
